title: Doctor, engineer or lawyer? Each type answers
caption:
Every desi kid has had this conversation. Here's how each type handles it.

Some bring a five-year plan with salary data. One argues so well against law that everyone decides they should be a lawyer. Some just quietly build something.

The useful bit: the better question isn't 'which job?' but 'which problems do you enjoy solving?' Your type is a good place to start.

Send this to a sibling or cousin who's choosing right now.
